rules.title: Set up both
rules.description: Enter your app's URL, start a Synthetic Monitoring uptime check on it, and get the Frontend Observability snippet for the same origin. Requires Editor access.

rules.title: Synthetic Monitoring
rules.description: Open Synthetic Monitoring to explore checks and monitor your website's availability and response time.

rules.title: Frontend Observability
rules.description: Open Frontend Observability to explore applications and understand the experience of people using your website.

blocks.title: See how real users experience your app
blocks.description: From the outside in — uptime, speed, from anywhere — to the inside out — real sessions, real errors. One guided setup covers both.

blocks.content: Create an uptime check and prepare the Frontend Observability snippet for the same website.

blocks.label: Prefer to set them up separately?

blocks.content: Either way, you can add the other later.
